Problem Statement

Write a program to perform division of two integers and handle exceptions that may occur during the operation.

Description

Read two integers:

Dividend
Divisor

Perform the following operations:

Divide the dividend by the divisor.
If the divisor is zero, handle the exception gracefully.
Display the division result if successful.
Display an appropriate error message if an exception occurs.
